predictions.articleTitle: Chonburi FC vs Uthai Thani Match Analysis & Preview: Can Chonburi's Home Revival Slow Gama's Attack?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Uthai Thani's superior 1.88-goal-per-game attacking output and full-strength core make Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes the strongest probabilistic direction.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win leans toward an Uthai Thani 1:2 victory backed by a 1:1 draw hedge (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes supported by 2.94 combined lambda and porous clean-sheet rates (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
1:1 Full-Time Stalemate covering Chonburi's 14-day tactical reset and three consecutive 1:1 H2Hs (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Uthai Thani's 1.88-goal attack tests Chonburi's home revival under Withaya Laohakul.

spf.comment: Covers both Uthai Thani's 1:2 attacking-quality edge and a 1:1 draw, as Chonburi's recent defensive stabilization makes a pure away win less reliable.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.94 combined lambda (56.3% Poisson Over 2.5) and Uthai Thani's 1.88 goals scored alongside 1.62 goals conceded per league match.

btts.comment: Both defenses concede regularly (Chonburi 12.5% clean sheets, Uthai Thani ~25% clean sheets), aligning with the 58.7% Poisson BTTS projection.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Uthai Thani's finishing and squad-health advantage against Chonburi's absentees, while 1:1 mirrors three straight H2H draws.

goals.comment: 3 goals aligns with the 1:2 primary script and 22.4% Poisson density, while 2 goals covers the 1:1 stalemate at 22.8%.

bqc.comment: Reflects a cautious, level first half consistent with Chonburi's low early scoring share before second-half goals decide between 1:2 and 1:1.
